rating_set_source: the rating set of the hero-sketch-v1 prompt experiments: 16 design and full-body redraw pairs people rated as the same character (4-5 of 5), each redraw also paired with a design from the other design prompt and with another design from its own prompt; every pair asked twice. Noted prop changes: the two edits people noted (a sword added; a weapon moved to the other hand)

live_pairs.note: chosen pairs of the 25 live stage p runs, measured before same-character-v2 existed
